output.reason: The release note [ev-dd5406a09d5e] is only a title, but the linked PR [ev-825d5637095d][ev-52f028ee60f5] states what changed. Crossplane now adds the environment variables `REVISION_NAME`, `REVISION_UID` and either `PROVIDER_NAME` or `FUNCTION_NAME` to the provider and function runtime pods. Name values come through the downward API from the pod labels pkg.crossplane.io/function and pkg.crossplane.io/revision; the PR's example sets `REVISION_UID` as a literal value. The changed files [ev-3431e6cf1ca2] are limited to the package runtime controller (runtime_provider.go, runtime_function.go, runtime.go), which fits an added capability on all Crossplane-managed provider and function runtime deployments; the PR gives no breaking effect, so an operator who does nothing just gets new env vars that processes in those pods can read.
